newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Record for Western High Grown BOP tea at Colomobo.
newsitem.headline: Record for Western High Grown BOP tea at Colomobo.

text.p: A Western High Grown Broken Orange Pekoe tea invoice fetched a record 234 rupees per kg at this week's Colombo auction, the brokers involved in the transaction said on Thursday.
"This is the highest on record so far this year for a Western High Grown BOP grade," Eastern Brokers said in a statement.
The line of tea from Mattakelle Estate, Talawakelle, was bought by Unilever Ceylon Ltd, it said.

"The price obtained was unusually high at this time of the year," a broker said. "This year we have not seen the quality peaking during the Western quality season (from early March to end April) because the weather has been very dry."
The previous high for the same type of tea this year was 204 rupees per kg at the March 12 auction for a line of tea made by St. Coombs Estate in the same region. ($1=Rs 58.53)
